fixtures_not_new_game_rules.partial_heal_case: One HP missing; gains capped to one.

fixtures_not_new_game_rules.ranges: All shown successful active targets are three cells away; no new range curve or distance metric is chosen.
fixtures_not_new_game_rules.scope: Prepared laboratory scenes, not campaign AI or damage simulation.
